name: Brant Lake Farmers Market
tagline: Brant Lake Farmers Market in Brant Lake, NY: Get Fresh Produce at Clark's Country Mall
description: Brant Lake Farmers Market is a farmers market in 6752 State Route 8, NY, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
